files.name: dochi_rpg_maker-0.2.9-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.9 Change Log

  • Completely removed CustomNPCs (CNPC) as a required dependency.
  • Updated the keybind organization across Dochi's mods to ensure they are displayed in a consistent order.
  • Updated Creative Mode tab behavior to support DNPC integration.
  • Fabric/NeoForge only:
    • Added the ability to delete trainer battle logs.
    • Added a cleanup feature for battle data associated with despawned trainers.
